name: The Two Hermits
source:
Paul and Ray are brothers who have been living far away from society to live as a worshipper to a certain God. They were given an earthen bowl as their sign that they are acknowldged. They live in a constant routine that they have come to be accustomed to. Their love and care for one another is insepperable by any normal means necessary. 

[I]But I wonder, which one do I like more?[/I]

[From [url=https://chasejones.itch.io/the-two-hermits-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
保罗和雷是兄弟，他们一直远离社会，以崇拜某位神的方式生活。他们得到了一个陶碗，作为他们得到认可的标志。他们生活在他们已经习惯的固定的日常生活中。他们对彼此的爱和关心是通过任何必要的正常手段都密不可分的。

[I]但我想知道，我更喜欢哪一个？[/I]

[来自[url=https://chasejones.itch.io/the-two-hermits-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
